assertions.claim: Mechanism: filler enters a facial vessel, flows backward, occludes the ophthalmic artery, instant blindness — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 填充剂被推进面部血管、逆流堵住眼动脉，人当场就看不见了

assertions.claim: More than 80% of the injections were hyaluronic acid — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 八成以上打的是玻尿酸

assertions.claim: Only 20.8% full visual recovery, 16.7% partial, rest none; nearly a fifth had brain complications — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 只有 20.8% 视力完全恢复，16.7% 部分恢复，剩下的没恢复；将近两成还出现了脑部并发症

assertions.claim: No rescue method proven consistently effective; the only protection is avoiding these zones in advance — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 目前没有一种抢救办法被证明稳定有效，所以这件事只能靠事前避开

assertions.claim: Case summary without a denominator, so per-injection blindness probability cannot be computed — preserved in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 没有分母，算不出「打一次的失明概率」

assertions.claim: Standard risk-reduction routine in licensed facilities (vessel mapping, blunt needles, small aliquots on withdrawal, hyaluronidase on hand) requires a trained physician — preserved in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 术前评估血管走行、用钝针、边退边小量注射、随时准备透明质酸酶
